concepts.gloss_en: "Limping on his thigh" (Gen. 32:32) — the aspect of the blemish of the legs/speech (pegam ha-raglin) before rectification

reason_for_human: Single occurrence of a single fixed phrase (the Genesis 32:32 quotation), used consistently throughout the paragraph as an 'aspect' of pegam ha-raglin. The 'שהוא בחינת פגם הרגלין' link is an equation, not a merge, so nothing else folds in. Straightforward standalone concept.
